FAQs About New Homes for Sale in Phoenix

    • Buying a House in Phoenix

      • How can I buy a new home in Phoenix?

      Buying a new home in Phoenix is simple with our easy process! From determining your budget, to helping you find your dream layout amongst our Phoenix new homes for sale, to being with you throughout the home building process, Pulte is proud to partner with you during your home buying journey. Learn more about our home buying process today or connect with one of our informed sales specialists and see how we support you at every step.
      Read More
    • Living in Phoenix

      • What is it like to live in Phoenix?

      Home to Chase Field and Symphony Hall, Phoenix is also known for its breathtaking landscapes, year-round sunny weather, and championship golf courses. If you’re active, you’ll love all of the family-friendly trails and rivers to explore like Camelback Mountain and The Grand Canyon. New homes for sale in areas like Buckeye and Tolleson are conveniently located in great school districts, making it easy to call Phoenix-- home.
    • Home Builder Warranties

      • Do Phoenix home builders offer a home warranty?

      While many home builders offer warranties, Pulte Homes is proud to offer one of the top new construction warranties in the industry! Our easy-to-use 10-year limited structural warranty is paired with coverage of our materials and workmanship, plumbing, electrical, HVAC, and other mechanical systems, so you can rest easy in your quality construction new home. Check out our warranty today.
      Read More

      New Home Builders in Phoenix

      Save Video.
      As one of the nation's leading new home builders in Phoenix, we bring more than 70 years of experience to the building process. This experience is reflected in each of our new construction homes and supported by our partnerships with trusted national suppliers—so you get a quality home built with premium building supplies. And that’s just the beginning of working with one of the largest home builders in Phoenix.

      Feel confident about the foundation you’re building when you design a home with Pulte. With our home builders’ warranty, you’ll get 10 years of coverage on the structural integrity of your home. And even when it comes to the smaller details, like energy efficiency, we’ve still got you covered. With Pulte Energy Advantage®, you can save more on your everyday expenses.

      When it comes to personalization, our custom home design can help you transform your space into something that feels unique to you. Find the perfect layout to fit your family's needs and explore how you can customize your space for a home office, game center, or gym. You’ll also enjoy more connectivity in our high-quality homes with hardwired internet options and USB outlets. Plus, build the kitchen of your dreams with help from Kitchenology™. Our kitchen layouts feature open-concept designs for plenty of natural light and oversized pantries.

      Choose Pulte as your Phoenix new home builder and discover a home with More Life Built In®. 

      Buy A New Home in Phoenix

      Save Video.
      Learn more about the home buying process  in Phoenix through our Build Quality Experience™. From the start of your search for new homes to celebrating your move-in day, our home builders will be with you every step of the way. We’re here to help make buying a new home in Phoenix as simple as possible. And that means connecting you to the right people to make your dream come true—including our Pulte Mortgage specialists, who can help you understand your budget and financing options.

      Discover all of our single-story new homes for sale in Phoenix online or talk to a sales specialist. They can also help you decide which size and layout would be best for you or help you learn more about pricing and tours. Once you’ve finalized your home plan, your construction manager will set up a plan for staying in contact.

      Our goal is for you to feel informed and involved in every step of the process. From your Pre-Drywall Orientation, where you’ll have the opportunity to get a guided walk-through of your home’s inner workings, to your Pre-Closing Orientation and welcome home celebration—with Pulte homes, you’ll get a full view of your house truly becoming a home.

      Owning A New Home in Phoenix

      Save Video.
      The locations of our new construction homes in Phoenix have been carefully chosen to help you feel like you’re at the center of it all. Find yourself within a close commute to top employers in Phoenix, including Banner Health, JP Morgan Chase, Wells Fargo, Amazon, UPS, Honeywell, and American Airlines. Plus, enjoy convenient access to grocery stores, retail stores, and a few parks or trails.

      Owning a new construction home in Phoenix allows for warm weather and clear skies almost year-round, making it a great place for outdoor adventure. Temperatures typically vary from 45°F to 107°F, rarely going above 112°F. And if you prefer to avoid the cold, you’ll appreciate that winters in Phoenix are mostly mild with the temperature rarely dropping below 37°F.

      Your journey to exploring all that Arizona has to offer starts here. Browse Pulte’s new construction homes in Phoenix and discover a new life at your fingertips.
